name: fast-laya-plugin
description: Verbatim compaction for Claude Code sessions, guided by a local Laya model.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Laya probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum state tokens per call
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated Laya token budget for the state sent with each tool call. Keep it about 100 below the checkpoint max_len (512 for laya, 1024 for laya-multilingual).

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Laya decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

model.title: Laya checkpoint
model.description: Checkpoint laya-serve should use: laya (English, 512 tokens), laya-multilingual (1024 tokens), or any name laya-serve accepts; unknown names auto-route.

concurrency.title: Parallel requests
concurrency.description: Laya requests in flight at once (laya-serve answers 503 above LAYA_MAX_CONCURRENT, 16 by default).

autoStart.title: Start laya-serve automatically
autoStart.description: When the endpoint is local (127.0.0.1, localhost, ::1) and not answering, start laya-serve in the background at session start and before compaction.

layaServeCommand.title: laya-serve command
layaServeCommand.description: Executable started by autoStart; a name on PATH or an absolute path.

startupTimeoutSeconds.title: laya-serve startup timeout
startupTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds compaction waits for an auto-started laya-serve to answer /health before falling back to the built-in summary.
